name: Radish
note: Chef Micaela Erickson's restaurant and small market opens Tuesday, Dec. 15, with a holiday menu.

name: Babe's Ice Cream
note: The seasonal scoop shop wrapped up its year with buy-one-get-one specials; no reopening date posted yet.

name: Buttah and Biscuit
note: The biscuit bakery, now baking in the Bay View Community Center kitchen, showed off the empty room it is turning into its first storefront. Location and opening date not announced yet.

name: Café Corazón Bay View
note: Last day after 10 years on KK; the Riverwest and Brown Deer locations stay open.

name: Ni Burmese
note: The mother-daughter Burmese restaurant announced it had closed after about a year and a half.

name: Supermoon Beer Co. taproom
note: The taproom closed; the brewery says it will keep making beer for bars, restaurants and stores.

name: Solemn Oath Brewery taproom
note: The Illinois brewery is taking over the former 1840 Brewing space for a taproom and production brewery; it had targeted mid-2026.

name: Cedar Teeth
note: The sourdough pizza maker plans a counter-service restaurant, plus its production kitchen, a few doors from its current space.
